gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
He was ___ (COURAGE) enough to speak first.
She waited ___ (ANXIOUS) by the phone for news.
The closure of the mine will leave four hundred workers ___ (EMPLOY).
gaps.explanation: 'Leave somebody unemployed' — the negative adjective describes the workers.

gaps.sentence: The film was a critical and ___ (COMMERCE) success.
The signing of the armistice was a ___ (HISTORY) moment for the region.
gaps.explanation: 'Historic' = momentous, making history; 'historical' merely means related to the past.
